name: Orfej: Eho Aida
source: Orpheus and Eurydice — a retelling of the classic Greek myth. Orpheus descends into the Underworld to bring back his wife, but Hades sets a condition: perform for him. Features a rhythm minigame, a temptation system, and 3 endings.
